articles.summary: The Dalus MCP Connector uses the Model Context Protocol to connect your live SysML v2 systems model to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code. Generate requirements specs, ICDs and FMEAs, sync Jira and DOORS, and check traceability — from a prompt in the chat you already use.
articles.title: MCP for Systems Engineering: Your MBSE Model, Inside Claude, ChatGPT and the Tools You Already Use
